changelog.title: Domain Hub Architecture
changelog.description: Houses are now subject matter experts. Consolidated hubs, specialty courses, and prerequisite paths give every domain a single front door.

changelog.title: Python Expansion
changelog.description: Python Hub restructured with 34 modules across 3 tracks plus a full engineering specialty course. Standard library, graphics, games, and real-world projects.

changelog.title: New Houses
changelog.description: House of the Machine (AI) and Matrix House (prestige tier) join the roster. Ghost walks the digital substrate.

changelog.title: Ethical Hacking Essentials
changelog.description: Full offensive security course — 13 modules covering fundamentals through penetration testing. A Dark Arts staple.

changelog.title: WiFi Arsenal
changelog.description: 10 hands-on WifiForge labs. Recon, deauth, handshake capture, evil twin, rogue AP — the works.

changelog.title: Bug Hunting Initiative
changelog.description: New curriculum track for real-world vulnerability discovery. From recon to responsible disclosure.

changelog.title: Visual Identity
changelog.description: Emblems, mascots, and house branding across the platform. Every house has a face now.
